findings.source_en: Unfit to protect the realm of Mammon.
findings.issue: Mammon is transliterated مَمُّون everywhere else in this review range - 'عرش مَمُّون', 'الثورات التي تلت في مَمُّون', 'عملة مَمُّون', 'خريطة مَمُّون'. This row alone writes مامون, so the realm Lazlo dies protecting reads as a different place name.

findings.source_en: Starving yourself won't bring them back.
findings.issue: 'them' is Lazlo's two executed parents, and this memory set uses the Arabic dual for them consistently - 'لم أستطع إنقاذهما', 'استيقظا... أرجوكما', 'كانا ساذجَين'. Only this line drops to the plural يُعيدهم.
